label: С
description: Motion away from a place or person, plus 'with' as a companion relation.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Companion relation, instrumental case. 1. 'С тобой' means with you and takes the instrumental. 2. 'Всегда' adds the sense of always. 3. A core building block for real conversation.

missions.phrase: Я иду с тобой в кино.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion with a companion, instrumental case. 1. 'С тобой' keeps the companion relation in the instrumental. 2. 'Иду' is present walking motion. 3. The sentence pairs movement with togetherness.
Strategic focus: Coming from a place, genitive case. 1. 'С работы' marks departure from work in the genitive. 2. 'Пришёл' is completed motion. 3. One of the most natural everyday patterns.
Strategic focus: Ongoing departure, genitive case. 1. 'С работы' is the source in the genitive. 2. 'Идёт' is present motion. 3. The ongoing counterpart to 'пришёл с работы'.
Strategic focus: Return from a source, genitive case. 1. 'С моря' marks the place returned from in the genitive. 2. 'Вернулись' is plural completed motion. 3. A common travel-memory sentence.
Strategic focus: Leaving a station, genitive case. 1. 'С вокзала' marks the source in the genitive. 2. 'Идём' is plural walking motion. 3. Pairs neatly with 'мы идём на вокзал'.
Strategic focus: Removing something from a surface, genitive case. 1. 'С полки' marks the source in the genitive. 2. 'Взяла' is completed past tense. 3. A strong source contrast with 'на полке'.
Strategic focus: Ongoing removal from a surface, genitive case. 1. 'С полки' marks the source in the genitive. 2. 'Беру' is present tense. 3. Practical and easy to picture.

Strategic focus: Removing from a surface, genitive case. 1. 'Со стены' marks the source in the genitive; 'со' before the cluster. 2. 'Сняли' is a completed action. 3. Vivid and useful for household description.

Strategic focus: Ongoing removal from a surface, genitive case. 1. 'Со стены' is the source in the genitive; 'со' before the cluster. 2. 'Снимаю' is present tense. 3. The ongoing counterpart to the completed version.
Strategic focus: Leaving a place, genitive case. 1. 'С улицы' marks the source in the genitive. 2. 'Ушёл' is completed motion. 3. Useful for street and location contrasts.
Strategic focus: Ongoing departure from a place, genitive case. 1. 'С улицы' marks the source in the genitive. 2. 'Идёт' is present tense motion. 3. The sentence reinforces the exit idea.

missions.phrase: Я пришёл на вечеринку с другом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Companion relation, instrumental case. 1. 'С другом' means with a friend in the instrumental. 2. 'Пришёл' is completed motion. 3. Teaches the companion use of 'с'.

missions.phrase: Мы гуляем по парку с другом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion with a companion, instrumental case. 1. 'С другом' keeps the companion relation in the instrumental. 2. 'Гуляем' is plural present motion. 3. A useful everyday conversational line.
Strategic focus: Exit from work, genitive case. 1. 'С работы' marks departure in the genitive. 2. 'Вышла' is a completed motion verb. 3. An extremely common Russian daily-life pattern.
Strategic focus: Leaving class, genitive case. 1. 'С урока' marks the source in the genitive. 2. 'Иду' is present tense motion. 3. The sentence fits school life very naturally.

missions.phrase: Мы только что вышли с урока.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Completed departure from class, genitive case. 1. 'Вышли' is plural past motion. 2. 'С урока' marks the source in the genitive. 3. A perfect contrast to 'идём с урока'.

missions.phrase: Он пришёл на встречу с ним.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Coming together with someone, instrumental case. 1. 'С ним' is the companion form in the instrumental. 2. 'Пришёл' is completed motion. 3. A useful relation phrase in conversation.

missions.phrase: Они до сих пор живут с родителями.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Living with someone, instrumental case. 1. 'С родителями' is a stable companion relation in the instrumental. 2. 'Живут' is plural present. 3. Great for everyday family context.

missions.phrase: Я ушёл с ним из дома.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Departure with companion and source. 1. 'С ним' marks the companion in the instrumental. 2. 'Из дома' marks the source in the genitive. 3. Combines two movement ideas in one clean line.
